questions.question: A cylindrical riser of 6 cm diameter and 6 cm height has to be designed for a sand casting mould for producing a steel rectangular plate casting of 7 cm x 10 cm x 2 cm dimensions having the total solidification time of 1.36 minute. The total solidification time (in minute) of the riser is  _______
questions.explanation: [latex]\begin{aligned} V_{\text {casting }}&=7 \times 10 \times 2=140 \mathrm{cm}^{3} \\ A_{\text {casting }}&= 2(7 \times 10+7 \times 2+2 \times 10) \\ &=2 \times(70 \times 20 \times 14)\\&=2 \times 104=208 \mathrm{cm}^{2}\\ \qquad\left(\frac{V}{A}\right)_{\text {casting }}&=\frac{140}{208}=0.673 \mathrm{cm} \\ \qquad\left(\frac{V}{A}\right)_{\text {Top Riser }}&=\frac{\frac{\pi}{4} d^{3}}{\frac{\pi}{4} d^{2}+\pi d^{2}}=\frac{d}{5}\\ &=1.2\mathrm{cm}\qquad(\therefore d=h=6\mathrm{cm}) \end{aligned}[/latex] [latex]\begin{aligned} \left(\frac{V}{A}\right)_{\text {Bottom Riser }}&=\frac{\frac{\pi}{4} d^{3}}{\frac{\pi}{2} d^{2}+\pi d^{2}}=\frac{d}{6}=1 \mathrm{cm} \\ \frac{t_{R}}{t_{C}}&= \frac{(V / A)_{\text {Top Riser }}^{2}}{(V / A)_{\text {Casting }}^{2}}=\left(\frac{1.2}{0.673}\right)^{2} \\ \Rightarrow t_{R}&=4.133 \text { minute } \text { (for top riser) }\\ \frac{t_{R}}{t_{C}} &=\frac{(V / A)_{\text {Bottom Riser }}^{2}}{(V / A)_{\text {Casting }}^{2}}=\left(\frac{1}{0.673}\right)^{2} \\ \Rightarrow t_{R} &=3 \text { minute } \quad \text { (for bottom riser) } \end{aligned}[/latex] Solidification time considering top and bottom riser comes under range given in the answer.
questions.explanation_html:
[latex]\begin{aligned} V_{\text {casting }}&=7 \times 10 \times 2=140 \mathrm{cm}^{3} \\ A_{\text {casting }}&= 2(7 \times 10+7 \times 2+2 \times 10) \\ &=2 \times(70 \times 20 \times 14)\\&=2 \times 104=208 \mathrm{cm}^{2}\\ \qquad\left(\frac{V}{A}\right)_{\text {casting }}&=\frac{140}{208}=0.673 \mathrm{cm} \\ \qquad\left(\frac{V}{A}\right)_{\text {Top Riser }}&=\frac{\frac{\pi}{4} d^{3}}{\frac{\pi}{4} d^{2}+\pi d^{2}}=\frac{d}{5}\\ &=1.2\mathrm{cm}\qquad(\therefore d=h=6\mathrm{cm}) \end{aligned}[/latex]
[latex]\begin{aligned} \left(\frac{V}{A}\right)_{\text {Bottom Riser }}&=\frac{\frac{\pi}{4} d^{3}}{\frac{\pi}{2} d^{2}+\pi d^{2}}=\frac{d}{6}=1 \mathrm{cm} \\ \frac{t_{R}}{t_{C}}&= \frac{(V / A)_{\text {Top Riser }}^{2}}{(V / A)_{\text {Casting }}^{2}}=\left(\frac{1.2}{0.673}\right)^{2} \\ \Rightarrow t_{R}&=4.133 \text { minute } \text { (for top riser) }\\ \frac{t_{R}}{t_{C}} &=\frac{(V / A)_{\text {Bottom Riser }}^{2}}{(V / A)_{\text {Casting }}^{2}}=\left(\frac{1}{0.673}\right)^{2} \\ \Rightarrow t_{R} &=3 \text { minute } \quad \text { (for bottom riser) } \end{aligned}[/latex]
Solidification time considering top and bottom riser comes under range given in the answer.

questions.question: A cast iron block of 200 mm length is being shaped in a shaping machine with a depth of cut of  4 mm, feed of 0.25 mm/stroke and the tool principal cutting edge angle of 30[latex]^{\circ}[/latex]. Number of cutting strokes per minute is 60. Using specific energy for cutting as 1.49 J/[latex]mm^{3}[/latex], the average power consumption (in watt) is _______
questions.explanation: The volume rate of material removal is: [latex] \begin{aligned} Q&=f d L N \\ \text { where } f(\text { feed })&=0.25 \mathrm{mm} / \mathrm{stroke} \\ d(\text { depth of } \mathrm{cut})&=4 \mathrm{mm} \\ \quad L(\text { length of block })&=200 \mathrm{mm} \end{aligned}[/latex] N(number of cutting stroke per minute) =60 [latex] \begin{aligned} Q&=\frac{0.25 \times 4 \times 200 \times 60}{60}\left(\frac{m m^{3}}{s}\right)\\ &=200 \mathrm{mm}^{3} / \mathrm{s} \\ U_{c} &=1.49 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{mm}^{2} \\ P_{\text {average }} &=U_{c} \times Q=1.49 \times 200 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{s}=298 \mathrm{W} \end{aligned}[/latex]
questions.explanation_html:
The volume rate of material removal is:
[latex] \begin{aligned} Q&=f d L N \\ \text { where } f(\text { feed })&=0.25 \mathrm{mm} / \mathrm{stroke} \\ d(\text { depth of } \mathrm{cut})&=4 \mathrm{mm} \\ \quad L(\text { length of block })&=200 \mathrm{mm} \end{aligned}[/latex]
N(number of cutting stroke per minute) =60
[latex] \begin{aligned} Q&=\frac{0.25 \times 4 \times 200 \times 60}{60}\left(\frac{m m^{3}}{s}\right)\\ &=200 \mathrm{mm}^{3} / \mathrm{s} \\ U_{c} &=1.49 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{mm}^{2} \\ P_{\text {average }} &=U_{c} \times Q=1.49 \times 200 \mathrm{J} / \mathrm{s}=298 \mathrm{W} \end{aligned}[/latex]
